title: proven-by-is-demanded-at-proved-and-askable-only-earlier
author: CC
owner: CC builds it; cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master owns the clearance gate
intention: The clearance gate refuses PROVED with [proof_named] when no crossing since BUILDME carries proven_by — but PROVED is the LAST crossing, and by the time the lack is named the crossing that should have carried the proof is already journaled and append-only. The only repair is a back-edge into the record of truth. Name the lack where it can still be supplied: the PROVEME crossing, which is the crossing that claims the build is proved, must refuse without proven_by.
why: The record of truth is append-only by design (Law 7), so a gate that can only be satisfied by editing history is a gate that teaches builders to edit history. Measured this session: satisfying it took a back-edge to PROVEME, a commit, a forward re-cross, and a second commit — four acts and two extra journal entries, none of which say anything about the build. The information was available at PROVEME and nothing asked for it.
how: Fire the same _coverage_lacks predicate the PROVED rung uses (clearance.py:1340) at the PROVEME crossing, restricted to the [proof_named] lack alone — hollow evidence legitimately cannot exist yet at PROVEME, so [hollow_evidence_absent] must stay where it is. My read, NOT ruled: PROVEME demands a named proof, PROVED keeps both lacks, and the PROVED [proof_named] check becomes the backstop it was always meant to be rather than the first time anyone asks. Also check whether emit's own PROVEME arm is the right site rather than the clearance machine, since PROVEME today rides bare emit while PROVED rides clear().
falsifier: DONE when a PROVEME crossing carrying no proven_by is refused by name, the refusal says which argument is missing, and a voyage that supplies it at PROVEME reaches PROVED without any back-edge. WRONG INTENT if the answer is to let PROVED accept a proof named on the clear() call alone — proven_by is journal-derived on purpose (crossings.py:242 proven_by_since_buildme), because a proof named only in an argument leaves no record for the hollow check to read, and hollow reads the journal.
traces_to: Law 7 (the record of truth is permanent — a gate whose only repair is a back-edge turns an append-only journal into an editable one); Law 1 (the resolver is spent on the novel — four acts to supply one already-known fact); Law 4 (the rule is real physics already; its FIRING POINT is the defect).
watchme: none, because the falsifier is checkable deterministically at the gate itself and the next voyage through PROVEME is its own live fire; a probe would watch for back-edges, which is the symptom rather than the rule.
gates_bound: proof gate — a proof beside the harbor_master that crosses a fixture voyage to PROVEME without proven_by and asserts the refusal; it must pass against today's code by NOT being refused, so the tooth reds until the fix lands.
feeds back to origin on failure — a red routes to this ticket's own voyage.
durability gate — not done until proven AND committed.
children: none, because it is one predicate fired at one more place

measured_at_cast.reading_1: clear(..., 'PROVED') raised Uncovered with 2 lacks: [proof_named] 'the ticket has crossings and none carries proven_by' and [hollow_evidence_absent] 'no hollow reading'.
measured_at_cast.reading_2: the PROVEME crossing had already been emitted without proven_by and nothing refused it.
measured_at_cast.reading_3: PROVEME -> PROVEME is IllegalTransition ('a no-op at position 3'), so a back-edge cannot be repaired by re-crossing to the same summons; the evidence has to ride the NEXT forward crossing, which in this voyage was WATCHME.
measured_at_cast.reading_4: clearance.py:1296 builds _named from clear()'s own proven_by argument, while cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py reads crossings.proven_by_since_buildme — two different sources for the same fact, which is why naming a proof at clear() alone did not satisfy hollow.

decisions.text: The check sits in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py emit(), in the forward arm where target == 'PROVEME' and target_idx > wf.cursor, placed AFTER the entry-gate block at that same crossing (the entry gate asks whether the build was CHARTED, this seat asks whether it is PROVEN; in the voyage the chart comes first, so a builder wrong about both hears EntryGateRed first and ProofNamedRed fires only for a charted build). It fires only when journal_extra.get('ticket') is not None. A ticketless PROVEME crossing records proof_gate: 'not_checked' and appends NO lane — exactly the entry gate's v0 jurisdiction, which appends no lane for a ticketless BUILDME->PROVEME crossing. PROVED's clearance rung (clearance.py _coverage_lacks) is untouched: [proof_named] and [hollow_evidence_absent] both stay there as the backstop.
decisions.step: unlisted: the site of the check

decisions.text: The predicate is the UNION the record will read: cairn.tools.base.crossings.proven_by_since_buildme(ticket) plus this crossing's own journal_extra['proven_by'] normalised to a list (a str is one path, a list is many, None/'' is none). Empty union -> raise ProofNamedRed(IllegalTransition) — a new sibling of EntryGateRed/BuildGateRed/ExitGateRed, never a subclass — whose message names the missing argument verbatim: 'proven_by'. Nothing is written before the raise. THE RECORD FIELD: proof_note is computed in the seat block — None when the crossing is not a forward PROVEME crossing, 'not_checked' when ticketless, and on pass exactly f'clean — proof named: {names}' where names is ', '.join(named or since_buildme) as returned by _proof_named_gate; it enters the crossing's journaled record dict as **({'proof_gate': proof_note} if proof_note else {}) immediately after the 'entry_gate' key. A refusal raises ProofNamedRed before the record dict is built, so a refused crossing has no proof_gate value and no record.

A new inspect_proof_named(ticket, journal_extra) -> list[dict] in transitions.py returns ONE lane, identity the_proveme_crossing_names_its_proof, built by _lane with code 'transitions.py::inspect_proof_named', expected/actual text, and values {'ticket', 'named': [...], 'since_buildme': [...]}. The lane is appended to the crossing's proved list on PASS, and on REFUSAL the raise carries it as findings (the _findings_of shape, keyed by 'method'). It is NOT appended for a ticketless crossing — that crossing carries only the proof_gate: 'not_checked' field on its record, so the existing exact-identity assertion over ticketless records in test_transitions.py stays green without editing that file (D6).

Proof at cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_proveme_names_its_proof.py, module-level PROVES = {'7203db7f151e': {'all': 'test_a_proveme_crossing_without_a_proof_is_refused_by_name'}} (the falsifier is one unnumbered clause, so one composite tooth). The tooth binds ProofNamedRed and inspect_proof_named at call time via getattr (a hollow reversion of transitions.py reds the tooth rather than crashing the runner), drives emit() over a tmp history/state pair with workflow 'bug@v1: THINKME -> TICKETME -> [BUILDME] -> PROVEME -> PROVED' and a fixture ticket id no journal carries (proven_by_since_buildme must return [] for it). FIXTURE: because the real entry gate refuses a chartless fixture ticket before the seat is reached (D1), legs (a) and (b) run with transitions._entry_gate replaced (setattr, restored in finally) by a stub returning ('clean — fixture chart', []) and transitions._stamp_sail replaced by a no-op (a fixture ticket must not claim the live sail record in instance-space); the seat, ProofNamedRed, inspect_proof_named and the history write are all REAL. (a) no proven_by -> ProofNamedRed whose message contains 'proven_by' and the ticket id, whose findings carry exactly one lane of that identity, and the history file does not exist; (b) proven_by='cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_proveme_names_its_proof.py' -> emit returns a string whose cursor stands at PROVEME, the journaled record's proof_gate starts with 'clean — proof named:' and its proved list carries exactly one lane the_proveme_crossing_names_its_proof with expected == actual; (c) ticket=None, real gates -> emit succeeds, the record's proof_gate == 'not_checked', and NO lane of that identity is in proved. Runner: if __name__ == '__main__': from cairn.tools.proof_coverage.proof_coverage import print_teeth_main; raise SystemExit(print_teeth_main(__file__)).

Validation: cairn/tools/base/validations/test_proveme_names_its_proof.json, sealed by PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m cairn.devices.tester.cli --seal --timeout 600 cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_proveme_names_its_proof.py (green seal) and then --hollow 7203db7f151e --seal (hollow reading). The seal runs inside this ticket's own voyage, in this order: rehearse CLEAN -> cross BUILDME through transitions.emit with proven_by=cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_proveme_names_its_proof.py -> commit transitions.py and the proof (the hollow revert reverts to the commit standing at the BUILDME crossing) -> rehearse CLEAN again -> cross PROVEME with the same proven_by -> seal -> write the verdict -> clear PROVED through harbor_master.clearance.clear. The 'reaches PROVED without any back-edge' half of the falsifier is that live fire, and the verdict cites the PROVEME crossing.

decisions.text: No exemption roster, no widening: _require_named_ticket, _entry_gate, the exit gate, and clearance.py are byte-identical before and after (git diff on those functions is empty). Back-edges into or out of PROVEME stay ungated. The existing proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_transitions.py is not edited (it carries uncommitted work of ticket 77f15efd5a96).
